result.reason: The clause satisfies the fallback by allowing mutual successor assignments upon written notice and applying a reasonableness standard to consent for other assignments. It also includes the preferred protection against termination following Client’s change of control. It does not reach the full preferred position because Vendor assignments are not subject to a Client-competitor prohibition or an asymmetric consent requirement. The redline is somewhat broader than necessary: it adds reorganization, an unreasonable-delay standard, and prohibitions on suspension and repricing that are not required by the stated fallback or the preferred no-termination protection. Otherwise, the changes are targeted and professionally drafted.
